evidence.detail: Log shows '[Golem] puts triggered ability onto the stack (turn face down)' then '[League] Invalid Match' — PDBot is interpreting the Golem token (generated by Vesuvan Shapeshifter copying a token) as a non-PD-legal card
No code in this repository emits the '[League] Invalid Match' string — it originates in the PDBot MTGO bot binary
PDBot is not among the listed modules in this repository; it is a separate MTGO bot project at pdbot.pennydreadfulmagic.com

triage.notes: The root cause is PDBot seeing a generic '[Golem]' token name in the MTGO game log and treating it as a non-PD-legal card, rather than recognizing it as a token generated by a legal card. The fix lives in PDBot's own codebase (not this repo). Someone with PDBot access should investigate its card-name validation logic to skip or whitelist generic token names.
